data.name: Trick Throw
data.description: When you successfully trip an opponent with an unarmed attack, you can attempt a dirty trick combat maneuver against that creature (before the opponent becomes prone) as an immediate action that does not provoke attacks of opportunity. This ability replaces the 8th-level bonus feat.
